answer: Since the measured length is checked against the declared class, the yarrow audit records the value and keeps the rejection reason. The length band is a cap tied to the mechanism class, 172 to 316 characters here, and an answer outside it is rejected as padded or truncated before the beacon identity is graded at all. A farm cannot pad a short template to fit, as the duplicate check runs on the padded text and the lotus band is published for each class. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
